'''Rand Lokta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] trainer who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. At one point in history, he trained the Imperial agent [[Cipher Nine]].
